title: Tunisian Pork Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish made with tender pork, rich tagine sauce, and a hint of creamy Tunisian spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the browned pork back to the pot, along with the Tunisian spice blend, chicken broth, and tagine sauce.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the heavy cream.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
